params.name: start_date

params.name: end_date
params.description: Get deliveries created before and at this datetime

params.name: pickup_start_date
params.description: Get deliveries picked up at and after this datetime

params.name: pickup_end_date
params.description: Get deliveries picked up before and at this datetime

params.name: hub_scanned
params.description: Whether shipments label have been scanned

items.docs:
This API is for merchants who are subscribed to the BackShip service.

Once an orderline has been accepted via the Orderline API, a shipping label is automatically created corresponding
to this orderline and can be retrieved from this endpoint via the field `labelUrl`.
The state of the orderline must be updated once the product has been shipped.
